title: Fill and copy with rep
description:
Write two functions with the `rep` string instructions:

| Function | Does | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `fill(dst, n, byte)` | sets `n` bytes at `dst` to the low byte of `byte` (`rep stosb`) | `dst` |
| `copy_bytes(dst, src, n)` | copies `n` bytes from `src` to `dst` (`rep movsb`) | `dst` |

Both work for `n` = 0 (they then change nothing).

starter.solution.asm:
fill:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

copy_bytes:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
fill:
        mov     r8, rdi
        mov     eax, edx
        mov     rcx, rsi
        cld
        rep stosb
        mov     rax, r8
        ret

copy_bytes:
        mov     rax, rdi
        mov     rcx, rdx
        cld
        rep movsb
        ret

hints: `rep stosb` stores `al` at `[rdi]` `rcx` times; `rep movsb` copies `rcx` bytes from `[rsi]` to `[rdi]`. Put the count in `rcx` first (lesson 8.01).
Both instructions move `rdi` forward, so keep the original `dst` in a scratch register to return it.
